issues.extracted: charges for services/fees (Charges for services 49,734, unsplit)
issues.on_page: Charges for services 49,734 = General park and pool 23,766 (p18) + Street rentals 4,440 (p21) + Community Development rent receipts 18,000 (p28) + Library fees 3,528 (p23)
issues.issue: The fund schedules print the full breakdown, and the same report's 'Other' 639,006 was split this way. Splitting this line would give Recreation Fees 23,766, Rentals 22,440 and charges for services 3,528, matching the detail lines (Rentals / Recreation Fees). Keeping it whole is defensible because no part is over half, but it is inconsistent.

issues.on_page: Economic reuse - loan payments 110,117 (p24); Housing reuse - loan payments 14,733 (p25); Loan repayments 4,643 (p27)
issues.issue: The same three loan-repayment lines carry detail_category 'Loan Collections' in detail[62], detail[69] and detail[80], but the split receipt line made from them carries 'Other / Miscellaneous Receipts'. The same label gets a different category in two places.

issues.on_page: Other operating revenues 21,418 (Sewer); p14: noncash 'Solar credits applied to utility bills' 21,418
issues.issue: The report says what this line is: solar credits applied to sewer utility bills. It could be Utility Charges rather than other. This is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Transportation 43,988 = General Fund Transportation - Airport 43,988 (p20); combined schedule p17 labels it 'Transfer to Airport Authority' 43,988
issues.issue: This is a payment to a separate Airport Authority (another entity, so spending, not an interfund transfer). Filing it under streets/highways is questionable, and detail[34] could take detail_category 'grants/payments to other entities' instead of 'not itemized'.

issues.on_page: p17 combined schedule: 'Net transfer to insurance fund' 8,216 (budget 30,499 = same budget as p19 Employee benefits); p31: Employee Benefit department operating expenditures 8,216
issues.issue: The governmental funds statement (p6) counts this as general government spending, so it was recorded as spending. But the combined schedule calls it a net transfer to an insurance fund, which is not among the reported governmental funds. It may be a one-sided transfer.

issues.on_page: Net transfer to insurance fund 8,216; Transfer to Airport Authority 43,988
issues.issue: decision_needed[] is missing. A person should confirm two items: whether the General Fund 'Employee benefits' 8,216 (called 'Net transfer to insurance fund' on p17) is spending or a transfer, and whether the Airport 43,988 ('Transfer to Airport Authority') is spending by function.

issues.on_page: Combined all-fund-types budget schedule: USDA payment 140,000 (budget 231,380) (p17) = sewer bond principal paid 140,000 (p13); Loan proceeds 151,907 (budget 325,280) (p16) = Water loan proceeds 151,907 (p13)
issues.issue: The rule asks for each utility fund's debt service and financing lines from the all-funds budget schedule. These two lines can be traced to the Sewer and Water funds through the cash-flow statement, but the schedule prints no fund column. The extractor left them out on purpose (see notes), so this is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Police - Debt service 5,609; p6 General Fund prints Principal 5,424 and Interest and fees 185
issues.issue: The governmental funds statement prints the principal/interest breakdown of this line, so the combined category is not strictly needed. This is minor.
